text: House File 2346 - Introduced HOUSE FILE 2346 BY COMMITTEE ON JUDICIARY (SUCCESSOR TO HF 803) (SUCCESSOR TO HF 464) A BILL FOR An Act relating to court-ordered substance use disorder 1 evaluations for persons convicted of operating while 2 intoxicated. 3 BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF THE STATE OF IOWA: 4 TLSB 2786HZ (1) 91 th/ns H.F. 2346 Section 1. Section 321J.2, subsection 7, paragraph a, Code 1 2026, is amended to read as follows: 2 a. All persons convicted of an offense under subsection 2 3 shall be ordered, at the person’s expense, to undergo , prior 4 to sentencing, a substance use disorder evaluation. The court 5 shall order the person to follow the recommendations proposed 6 in the substance use disorder evaluation as provided in section 7 321J.3 . 8 EXPLANATION 9 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 10 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 11 Under current law, a person who is convicted of operating 12 while intoxicated must pay for and undergo a substance use 13 disorder evaluation prior to sentencing. This bill strikes the 14 requirement for the evaluation to occur prior to sentencing. 15 -1- LSB 2786HZ (1) 91 th/ns 1/ 1
